title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1987-06-21
source: Source: AKG 414 B/TL cardioids >  ORTF > Oade PS > Sony PCM FI > dat (44.1); Taped by Robert Bryant and provided by Rich Gastwirt; Transfer: Dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Sound Devices 744T > wav 16/44.1; Transfer by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick May 2017

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording with a loud crowd track, but a great first‑set opener featuring Alabama Getaway > Promised Land > West LA Fadeaway.
ai_review.review: The show captures the band in a semi‑experimental, fantastic form, highlighted by an impressive opening sequence of Alabama Getaway into Promised Land and West LA Fadeaway. The audience tape is usable, though the crowd mix is louder than the music at times, making it a bit sloppy but not a deal‑breaker.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review praises the performance strongly while noting minor audience‑mix issues; overall rating reflects strong show quality with fair recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd noise is on a separate track and often louder than the music, creating a sloppy mix but not severely detracting from listenability.

standout_songs: Alabama Getaway > Promised Land > West LA Fadeaway
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set is praised for its experimental vibe and strong opener; overall the night feels great though less raucous than preceding shows.
